text: SYNTHETIC DEMO ONLY. D1 Domestic category applies to an LT connection used exclusively as a residential dwelling. Residential lighting and household appliances are covered. This category definition alone does not determine the treatment of a business operated from a dwelling.

SYNTHETIC DEMO ONLY. C1 Commercial category applies to LT premises used exclusively for a shop, office, retail business or commercial services. A wholly commercial shop should be considered for the commercial category rather than the domestic category.

SYNTHETIC DEMO ONLY. I1 Industrial category applies to LT premises used exclusively for manufacturing or industrial production. A manufacturing workshop should be considered for industrial classification, subject to the declared activity and verified connected load.

SYNTHETIC DEMO ONLY. M1 Mixed-use modifier: where residential premises are partly used for tailoring, a shop, an office or another commercial activity, the domestic definition must be read with this provision. Do not automatically retain domestic classification or automatically classify the whole premises as commercial. Establish actual use, business area, total area, connected load and whether a separate meter serves the business. If these facts are incomplete or the category remains mixed, refer to a grievance officer and recommend a site inspection. This demo provision intentionally supplies no numerical exemption threshold.
